name: Star Coffee
source:
A game of language and choices. You are a new intern on a diplomatic space cruiser, and your new boss want you to go get him coffee. Too bad your translator doesn't English good.

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2015/games/star-coffee]Global Game Jam[/url]]
